description:
As an operator choosing the system default model, and a person chatting
  I want a change of model to apply to the next answer without a restart,
  and to see which model answered, why, and since when
  So that I can trust the model I chose is the model that served the reply

elements.name: Changing one conversation leaves the others alone

steps.name: the stub providers "openai", "bdd-provider-b" and "bdd-provider-c" are configured with models "gpt-5.4-mini", "claude-5-sonnet, claude-5-haiku" and "qwen-5-turbo"
the system default model is "openai/gpt-5.4-mini"
the system default model is "bdd-provider-b/claude-5-haiku"
a conversation "Chat Y" with no model override
a conversation "Chat X" with the model override "bdd-provider-c/qwen-5-turbo"
I switch to the conversation "Chat X"
I set the model override of this conversation to "openai/gpt-5.4-mini"
I send the message "S1 r5 x1"
I switch to the conversation "Chat Y"
I send the message "S1 r5 y1"
the reply to "S1 r5 x1" came from "openai/gpt-5.4-mini"
the reply to "S1 r5 y1" came from "bdd-provider-b/claude-5-haiku"
I switch to the conversation "Chat X"
I clear the model override of this conversation
I confirm the change
I send the message "S1 r5 x2"
I switch to the conversation "Chat Y"
I send the message "S1 r5 y2"
the reply to "S1 r5 x2" came from "bdd-provider-b/claude-5-haiku"
the reply to "S1 r5 y2" came from "bdd-provider-b/claude-5-haiku"
the operator changes the system default to "openai/gpt-5.4-mini"
I send the message "S1 r5 y3"
the reply to "S1 r5 y3" came from "openai/gpt-5.4-mini"
